plans.query: select "id", "planet_id", "queue", "slot", "kind", "subject", "count", "status", "started_at", "ready_at", "remaining_seconds", "cost" from "build_orders" where ("build_orders"."planet_id" = $1 and "build_orders"."status" = $2) order by "build_orders"."queue" asc, "build_orders"."slot" asc

select "intergalactic_convoy_runs"."id" from "intergalactic_convoy_runs" inner join "galaxy_event_occurrences" on "galaxy_event_occurrences"."id" = "intergalactic_convoy_runs"."occurrence_id" where ("intergalactic_convoy_runs"."planet_id" = $1 and "intergalactic_convoy_runs"."abandoned_at" is null and "galaxy_event_occurrences"."starts_at" <= $2 and "galaxy_event_occurrences"."ends_at" > $3) limit $4

Plans.Filter: ((starts_at <= '2026-10-25 21:54:46.546+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ends_at > '2026-10-25 21:54:46.546+00'::timestamp with time zone))

plans.query: select "owner_player_id", count(*) from "missions" where ("missions"."owner_player_id" in ($1) and "missions"."status" = $2 and ("missions"."kind" = $3 or ("missions"."kind" = $4 and "missions"."death_star_capture" = $5))) group by "missions"."owner_player_id"

select "id", "season_id", "anchor_kind", "anchor_id", "x", "y", "z", "radius", "intensity_hp_per_minute", "radiation_level", "origin", "bomb_flight_id", "mode", "active_from", "active_until", "label", "created_at" from "hp_radiation_sources" where ("hp_radiation_sources"."season_id" = $1 and "hp_radiation_sources"."active_from" <= $2 and ("hp_radiation_sources"."active_until" is null or "hp_radiation_sources"."active_until" > $3))

Plan.Filter: ((active_from <= '2026-10-25 21:54:46.546+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND ((active_until IS NULL) OR (active_until > '2026-10-25 21:54:46.546+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AND (season_id = '<redacted-uuid>'::uuid))

plans.query: select "id", "planet_id", "starts_at", "ends_at", "level", "active_from" from "planet_aegis_epochs" where ("planet_aegis_epochs"."planet_id" = $1 and "planet_aegis_epochs"."starts_at" < $2 and ("planet_aegis_epochs"."ends_at" is null or "planet_aegis_epochs"."ends_at" > $3)) order by "planet_aegis_epochs"."starts_at" asc

Plans.Filter: ((ends_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at > '2026-10-25 21:54:46.546+00'::timestamp with time zone))
